question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Artisen**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the correctly spelt word is '**Artisen**'. • **Artisan**: a person who makes things skilfully, especially with his/her hands. (कारीगर, शिल्‍पी) • *Example: The **artisan** can cut stones into various shapes.* **Correct Answer:__** *Artisen.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Electrician**: a person whose job is to make and repair electrical systems and equipment. (बिजली के उपकरणों की मरम्‍मत करने वाला; बिजली मिस्‍त्री) • **Technician**: a person whose work involves practical skills, especially in industry or science. [व्‍यावहारिक कौशलों की क्षमता वाला व्‍यकि्त (विशेषतः उद्योग या विज्ञान के क्ष्‍ोत्र में); तकनीकी कारीगर] • **Plumber**: a person whose job is to put in or repair water pipes, baths, toilets, etc. (नल का मिस्‍तरी, नलकार) 36:T860, The correct answer is '**Flee**'.
